hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Check if any 2-character substring of s also appears in s reversed.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A 2-character substring s[i:i+2] appears in the reversed string if and only if s[i+1] + s[i] appears in the original string.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Collect all adjacent pairs (s[i], s[i+1]). Check if the reversed pair (s[i+1], s[i]) is in the set.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear pass with set lookup is already optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a hash set of 2-character substrings to check membership in linear time.
